Name: Tillable Farm Grass
Author: chromamods
Description:
[size=5][b]Tillable Farm Grass[/b][/size]

Till the grass on your farm that the hoe normally skips. Works on any farm type, modded ones too.

Tilled grass blends into the grass around it, and turns back into grass once the soil is gone.

Hit grass with a pickaxe to turn it into dirt. Hit it again to get the grass back. With GMCM installed, there's a button in the mod options to bring back the hidden grass all at once.

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]SMAPI[/url] 4.0+ on Stardew Valley 1.6[/*]
[*]Optional: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url][/*]
[/list]Safe to add or remove mid-save. In multiplayer, every player needs it.

[url=https://github.com/chromamods/TillableFarmGrass]https://github.com/chromamods/TillableFarmGrass[/url]
